oneLine: Highway Roop acquires Chamundi Die Cast to build a scaled precision manufacturing platform.

sources.title: Carlyle-backed Highway Roop acquires Chamundi Die Cast to diversify auto components platform

synopsis: The Carlyle Group-backed Highway Roop Precision Technologies Ltd has acquired Chamundi Die Cast Pvt. Ltd to build a scaled, diversified precision manufacturing platform and advance its journey towards an initial public offering. Chamundi manufactures complex, precision-machined aluminium die-cast components for automotive and industrial applications. The financial details of the transaction were not disclosed by the companies. Chamundi's promoters, including managing director Yasin Khan, will continue to hold a stake in the combined entity.
